codeReview.summary: Core scaffolding is substantial, but contract-critical enforcement is incomplete: claim gating can pass without manifest consistency or per-run-type threshold conformance, and sampling/order controls are not strictly enforced at CLI/gate boundaries.

issues.description: VAL-BENCH-012 requires local/nightly/manual evidence on the same commit and manifests, but the gate checks only commit SHA consistency and never validates manifest-hash equality across runs (manifest_hashes is loaded but unused for gating). Mixed-manifest evidence can incorrectly pass.

Threshold evaluation is anchored to local-only primary_stats, while non-local runs are used only for direction agreement. This does not enforce that declared claim thresholds pass for each required run type (local + nightly + manual), as required by VAL-BENCH-012.

Overall gate result excludes scenario threshold outcomes (pair_evaluations/claim_allowed) and depends only on run-type, commit, parity, and reproducibility checks. Threshold failures can therefore still return gate=pass.

Order-bias validation passes whenever execution_schedule exists, without enforcing policy schedule type, seed presence/integrity, or schedule-vs-execution semantics. This is too weak for VAL-BENCH-010 enforcement.

The measured subcommand exits non-zero only on cell execution errors and ignores sampling validation failure status, allowing policy-violating runs to exit successfully instead of enforcing VAL-BENCH-006/010 at CLI level.

Regression coverage is incomplete for gate semantics: tests assert overall fail for missing run types but do not assert overall fail for threshold violations or mixed-manifest evidence, which allowed the above enforcement gaps to ship undetected.

sharedStateObservations.observation: benchmark-worker procedure is too high-level for claim-gate strictness; it does not explicitly require manifest-hash equality checks and per-required-run-type threshold enforcement, despite those being contract-critical.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/benchmark-worker/SKILL.md:20-22 defines generic enforcement; worker transcript marks followedProcedure=true, yet benchmarks/claim_gate.py:121-125,177-227,247-253 omit manifest equality and per-run-type threshold gating.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared mission docs emphasize local/nightly/manual evidence but under-specify same-manifest and strict threshold semantics compared to the validation contract, creating room for partial implementations.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md:26 and .factory/library/benchmarking.md:11 require run-type coverage; validation-contract.md:145-147 additionally requires same commit and manifests plus threshold-rule pass across the run set.

summary: Reviewed feature metadata, handoff, commit diff, transcript skeleton, and skill instructions. Marked FAIL with high confidence due to missing manifest-consistency enforcement, incomplete cross-run threshold gating, weak order-bias enforcement, and measured CLI not failing on sampling-policy violations.
